annotations.text:
The demo in four screens.

Shelf → Chat → X-ray → turn a decision off and watch the ranking move.
Chat runs on the Claude Agent SDK: retrieval is a tool the agent chooses to call, not a fixed pre-step. The X-ray shows that choice, then opens up what happened inside the call.
Counterfactuals stop before the model, so they are free and instant. Answering again is a separate, priced button — which is what lets this run in front of an audience all day.
